section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 2000
title: 2.10.3 The sex-wise break-up and details of percentage distribution of the means adopted for suicide in the various States/Uts & Cities are given in Table-26. Expectedly, for all the means of suicides, male victims were more except for suicides by 'Self immolation' where share of female victims was more (66.4%). 2.10.4 Besides Poisoning and Hanging other means which more than 30 per cent suicides in Punjab were committed by coming under 'Vehicles / Trains' while in Goa Drowning was the major mean sharing 26.5 per cent. About 19 per cent Suicides each in Delhi, Gujarat & Maharashtra were committed by 'Fire/Self Immolation'. An equal share (18.7%) in Nagaland was due to 'overdose by Sleeping Pills' etc. 2.11 SUICIDES IN CITIES
